label: practice

test_cases.label: copy() produces independent LinkedList with identical elements
test_cases.code:
lst = LinkedList()
assert list(lst.copy()) == []
for x in [3, 1, 4, 1, 5]: lst.insert(x)
cp = lst.copy()
assert list(cp) == [1, 1, 3, 4, 5]
assert cp.first is not lst.first
cp.insert(0)
assert list(lst) == [1, 1, 3, 4, 5]

test_cases.label: Person instances can be inserted and sorted in LinkedList
test_cases.code:
plst = LinkedList()
p1 = Person('Markus', '111')
p2 = Person('Gustav', '222')
p3 = Person('Anna', '333')
for p in [p1, p2, p3]: plst.insert(p)
assert [str(x) for x in plst] == ['Anna:333', 'Gustav:222', 'Markus:111']
